family: OR: L is the set of binary strings containing at least one 1, so f_n=OR_n on {0,1}^n for every n>=0, with f_0(empty)=0. A fixed linear-time scan computes f_n at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the scan accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(OR_n)>=n-1 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li–Yang B2 model, so liminf over all integer n of C_B2(OR_n)/n>=1.
